entries.title: Curvature closures differ on an actual smooth field
entries.summary: Provides a concrete smooth-field witness separating two closures, not merely distinct algebraic jets.
entries.limit: Uses the specified regularized family and parameter restrictions.
entries.statement:
theorem distinct_closures_on_actual_smooth_field
    (ε α S lam mu : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hS : 0 < S) (hne : lam ≠ mu) :
    ∃ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ) (x y : ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ψ p.1 p.2) ∧
      curvature ε α lam S (ψ x y) (laplaceComplex ψ x y) ≠
        curvature ε α mu S (ψ x y) (laplaceComplex ψ x y) :=

entries.title: Auxiliary variables do not remove a temporal instability
entries.summary: The auxiliary Hamiltonian is unbounded below along a specified momentum direction when the relevant coordinate is nonzero.
entries.limit: Restricted regular higher-time-derivative jet model, not every higher-derivative theory.
entries.statement:
theorem auxiliary_hamiltonian_unbounded_below
    (h k U Q pQ : ℝ) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (bound : ℝ) :
    ∃ p, auxiliaryReducedHamiltonian h k U Q p pQ < bound :=

entries.title: Invertible field redefinitions preserve the obstruction
entries.summary: A nondegenerate temporal Hessian remains nondegenerate under the stipulated invertible point change.
entries.limit: An exact obstruction class with a distinct competing spatial completion.
entries.statement:
theorem invertible_point_change_cannot_degenerate
    (coeff a b c d : ℝ)
    (hcoeff : coeff ≠ 0) (hjac : a*d-b*c ≠ 0) :
    0 < transformedHessianDet coeff a b c d :=

entries.title: Finite-wavenumber static onset obstruction
entries.summary: Excludes a primary finite-q zero-frequency static onset in the stated homogeneous S004 parameter sector.
entries.limit: Conditional on the model parameters and positive-curvature gap.
entries.statement:
theorem no_primary_finite_q_static_onset
    (K G T massSq q : ℝ)
    (hK : 0 < K)
    (hB : 0 < curvatureGap K G T)
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (hzero : inversePropagator K G T massSq 0 q = 0) :
    lowerPole K G T massSq 0 < 0 :=

entries.title: Positive static stiffness forbids a finite-q zero
entries.summary: Under the specified positivity inequalities, the static inverse propagator cannot vanish at q > 0.
entries.limit: Not a proof that all finite-wavelength dynamics are forbidden.
entries.statement:
theorem no_static_finite_q_onset (K G T massSq q : ℝ)
    (hK : 0 < K) (hB : 0 < 4 * K * T - G ^ 2)
    (hm : 0 ≤ massSq) (hq : 0 < q) :
    inversePropagator K G T massSq 0 q < 0 :=

entries.title: Regularized curvature denominator stays positive
entries.summary: A typed complex-field regularizer remains strictly positive when its epsilon parameter is positive.
entries.limit: Denominator safety is not a nonlinear PDE well-posedness or a physical confinement result.
entries.statement:
theorem complexRegularizerDenominator_positive
    (psi : ℂ) (epsilon alpha : ℝ) (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon) :
    0 < complexRegularizerDenominator psi epsilon alpha :=

entries.title: Randomization tests control type-I error
entries.summary: Establishes a finite-sample significance bound under a declared exchangeable null model.
entries.limit: A statistical theorem, not experimental confirmation of an optical phenomenon.
entries.statement:
theorem exchangeable_level {n : ℕ} (M : ExchangeableModel (n + 1)) (lvl : ℝ) (hlvl : 0 ≤ lvl) :
    M.prob (fun ω => pValue univ (M.X ω) 0 ≤ lvl) ≤ lvl :=

entries.title: Exact algebraic phase-lock closure
entries.summary: The defined closed-loop phase-correction coefficient satisfies the stated winding algebra identity.
entries.limit: An algebraic identity with a nonzero denominator, not an orbital-stability result.
entries.statement:
theorem alphaLock_closure
    (winding : ℤ) (integratedSigma integratedReciprocalWeight : ℝ)
    (hden : integratedReciprocalWeight ≠ 0) :
    alphaLock winding integratedSigma integratedReciprocalWeight *
        integratedReciprocalWeight + integratedSigma =
      2 * Real.pi * (winding : ℝ) :=

entries.title: A narrow scalar modal-growth bound
entries.summary: Bounds the derivative of a real scalar modal power under the displayed cubic-saturation ODE.
entries.limit: Scalar reduction only, not a theorem about arbitrary PDE Fourier modes.
entries.statement:
theorem e15_scalar_modal_growth_bound (A : ℝ → ℝ)
    (t growth c : ℝ)
    (hA : HasDerivAt A (growth * A t - c / 2 * (A t) ^ 3) t) :
    deriv (fun τ => (A τ) ^ 2) t ≤
      2 * growth * (A t) ^ 2 - c * (A t) ^ 4 :=

entries.title: Structural noninjectivity of a block readout
entries.summary: Exhibits distinct internal states with the same output under the defined readout.
entries.limit: Noninjectivity of a finite readout, not security or collision resistance of a complete cryptographic hash.
entries.statement:
theorem squeezeRound_not_injective :
    ∃ C C' : Fin 256 → CCField, C ≠ C' ∧ squeezeRound C = squeezeRound C' :=
